title: DataSpec Specification
description: JSON Schema for DataSpec YAML specification files. Defines the structure for CSV/Excel to database mapping with validation, transformation, masking, and lookup capabilities.

columns.description: Array of column mappings from source file (CSV/Excel) to database fields. Each column defines how to map, validate, transform, and optionally mask data.

metadata.description: Specification metadata including name, entity, and optional documentation.

name.description: Unique identifier name for this specification. Use snake_case or kebab-case.

description.description: Human-readable description explaining the purpose and usage of this specification.
examples: Import monthly transaction records from bank exports

entity.description: Entity type this spec belongs to. Used for organizing specs and determining target operations.

author.description: Author or team responsible for this specification.

tags.description: Tags for categorization and filtering specifications.

version.description: Version of this specific specification (separate from the spec format version).

database.description: Database configuration specifying the target table and key structure.

table.description: Target database table name where data will be imported.

primary_key.description: Primary key column name used for duplicate detection and updates.

schema.description: Database schema name if not using the default schema.

column.description: Defines mapping from a source column to a database column, including validation, transformation, and masking rules.

name.description: Target column name in the database table.

source.description: Source column name from the CSV/Excel file header. Case-sensitive match.

type.description: Data type for parsing and validation. Determines how source values are interpreted.
type.$comment: string: General text | number/integer/decimal: Numeric values | boolean: true/false | date/datetime/time: Temporal values | uuid: UUID format | json: JSON objects | array: Arrays | text: Long text

required.description: Whether this field must have a non-empty value. Rows with missing required fields will fail validation.

sensitivity.description: Data classification level determining default masking behavior and access controls.
sensitivity.$comment: public: No restrictions | internal: Company-only | confidential: Need-to-know | secret: Highly sensitive | highly_restricted: Maximum protection

validation.description: Array of validation rules to apply. All rules must pass for the value to be valid.

transform.description: Array of transformations to apply in order. Each transformation modifies the value before the next.

unmask_permissions.description: Roles or permissions required to view unmasked data. Users without these roles see masked values.

default.description: Default value to use when source value is empty or null. Type should match the column type.

validationRule.description: A validation rule to check against the column value.

message.description: Custom error message to display when validation fails.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern for 'regex' validation type.

min.description: Minimum value for 'range' validation or minimum length for 'length' validation.

max.description: Maximum value for 'range' validation or maximum length for 'length' validation.

script.description: JavaScript code for 'custom' validation. Must return true for valid, false for invalid. Available context: value, row, column.

transformation.description: A transformation to modify the column value.

format.description: Date format string for parse_date/format_date transformations. Uses moment.js/dayjs format.

timezone.description: Timezone for date operations. Uses IANA timezone names.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for round/floor/ceil transformations.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern for regex_extract/regex_replace transformations.

capture_group.description: Which capture group to extract for regex_extract (0 = full match, 1+ = specific group).

target_field.description: Target field to store extracted value (for regex_extract). If omitted, replaces current value.

replacement.description: Replacement string for regex_replace. Can include capture groups ($1, $2, etc.).

index.description: Array index to select after split transformation. Negative values count from end.

script.description: JavaScript code for 'custom' transformation. Must return the transformed value. Available context: value, row, column.

masking.description: Configuration for masking sensitive data during export or display.

mode.description: Masking mode: full (replace all), partial (keep some chars visible), regex (pattern-based), custom (JavaScript).

replacement.description: Character(s) to use for masked portions.

visible_chars.description: Number of characters to keep visible for 'partial' mode. Use with 'position' to control which end.

position.description: Which end to keep visible when using visible_chars. 'end' keeps last N chars, 'start' keeps first N chars.

partial_start.description: Number of characters visible at the start. Use for explicit control (alternative to visible_chars + position).

partial_end.description: Number of characters visible at the end. Use for explicit control (alternative to visible_chars + position).

regex_pattern.description: Regular expression pattern for 'regex' mode masking. Matched portions are replaced.

custom_script.description: JavaScript code for 'custom' mode. Must return the masked value. Available context: value, config.

lookup.description: Configuration for looking up values from reference tables (foreign key resolution).

table.description: Reference table to lookup values from.

oneOf.description: Single column name to match against.
Array of column names for composite key lookup.

key.description: Column(s) in the lookup table to match against. Use array for composite keys.

source_field.description: Source field to use for lookup value if different from the current column name.

return_field.description: Column to return from the lookup table. Defaults to the table's primary key (usually 'id').

fallback.description: Action when lookup fails: error (fail row), skip (skip row), default (use defaultValue), null (set null).

default_value.description: Default value to use when fallback='default' and lookup fails.

cache.description: Whether to cache lookup results for better performance on repeated values.

cache_ttl.description: Cache time-to-live in seconds. Only applies when cache=true.

hooks.description: Custom JavaScript hooks for extending import/export behavior at various execution points.

before_validate_row.description: Hooks executed before validating each row. Can modify row data before validation.

validate_field.description: Hooks for custom field validation. Return true/false or throw error.

before_lookup.description: Hooks executed before performing lookups. Can modify lookup parameters.

perform_lookup.description: Hooks for custom lookup logic. Can override default lookup behavior.

transform_field.description: Hooks for custom field transformation beyond built-in transforms.

mask_field.description: Hooks for custom masking logic beyond built-in modes.

unmask_field.description: Hooks for custom unmasking logic and permission checks.

before_insert.description: Hooks executed before inserting rows. Final chance to modify data.

after_insert.description: Hooks executed after successful insert. Useful for logging or notifications.

name.description: Unique name for this hook. Used for logging and debugging.

field.description: Specific field this hook applies to. If omitted, hook applies to all fields or row level.

script.description: JavaScript code to execute. Available context varies by hook type: { value, row, column, spec, adapter }.
examples: if (value.length !== 9) throw new Error('SSN must be 9 digits');

duplicate_strategy.description: How to handle rows with duplicate primary keys: skip (ignore), update (upsert), error (fail).

batch_size.description: Number of rows to process in each batch. Larger batches are faster but use more memory.

validate_foreign_keys.description: Whether to validate that lookup references exist before import.

auto_generate_ids.description: Whether to auto-generate UUIDs for primary key if not provided in source.

apply_masking.description: Whether to apply masking rules during export. Set false only for authorized full data exports.

include_audit_fields.description: Whether to include audit fields (created_at, updated_at, created_by) in export.
